name: rtx_5080
description: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (GB203, Blackwell, sm_120) at its 2295 MHz base clock: one Vortex core per SM.

sources.NUM_CORES, NUM_WARPS, NUM_THREADS, ISSUE: 84 SMs, 48 resident warps/SM, 4 schedulers x 32 lanes (NVIDIA RTX Blackwell GPU Architecture whitepaper, App. B; cudaGetDeviceProperties on the user's RTX 5080)
sources.DCACHE_SIZE: 128 KB L1/shared per SM (whitepaper App. B)
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS: 64 MB L2 (whitepaper App. B); 16 ways as in GPGPU-Sim's Ampere/Hopper L2 configs
sources.L2_NUM_BANKS: 32 banks as the nearest power of two to the 48 L2 slices measured by arXiv 2507.10789
sources.DCACHE_MSHR_SIZE, L2_MSHR_SIZE: 384 L1 MSHR entries per SM (24 x 16 banks) and 192 per L2 slice, GPGPU-Sim SM86_RTX3070 (-gpgpu_cache:dl1 A:384:48, dl2 A:192:4)
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_NUM_BANKS: 8 x 32-bit GDDR7 devices = 32 independent channels (whitepaper App. B)
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_PEA: 2295 MHz base clock, 960 GB/s (whitepaper App. B)
sources.reference: Nsight Compute on the user's RTX 5080, clocks locked to base, cold L2, 2026-10-05 (docs/reports/simx_vs_rtx5080_mlp_report.md)
